visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a large, dark stadium with dozens of bright spotlights beaming white and purple lights across the field. A man with blonde-styled hair and sunglasses, wearing a black-and-white vertically striped blazer, stands inside a white convertible Porsche positioned on the grass. A group of baseball players in white and blue uniforms stands in a line behind the car, while a massive overhead screen displays the word 'FIGHTERS' and a video of the man. (2) The car moves slowly forward across the field. The man waves both arms enthusiastically at the crowd in the dark stands, which are filled with tiny lights from fans' phones. He points toward the upper decks, smiling and gesturing with open palms. Overlays of yellow variety-style text appear briefly at the bottom. (3) The man steps out of the white car onto the green turf near the infield. He is immediately greeted by a red fox mascot wearing a baseball jersey and a female mascot in a blue and white cheerleader-style outfit. Bright yellow spotlights focus on the group, casting long shadows on the grass while the man continues to wave and smile. (4) The man walks toward a second row of players wearing orange and white uniforms. He raises his arms in a 'V' shape for victory, then walks past the players, offering fist bumps and handshakes. Several cameramen in black clothing follow him closely, capturing the interaction. The background is filled with the blurred faces of spectators in the massive stadium tiers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a pulsating synth bass and a sharp drum machine kick starts the track. A male narrator with an extremely high-arousal tone begins shouting an introduction in Mandarin. The background is thick with the sound of a roaring crowd and stadium-sized reverb. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes a visual transition. The narrator continues at a high pitch, his voice exhibiting a strong rising contour as he invites the crowd to cheer. The music maintains a constant high-tempo energy without variation in its core loop. (3) A subtle percussive thud occurs, coinciding with the man stepping on the ground. The narrator shifts to Japanese, his delivery becoming more rhythmic and melodic, perfectly syncing with the upbeat BGM. Crowd noise peaks as multiple whistles and screams are audible in the high-frequency spectrum. (4) The narrator’s volume remains dominant as he announces the guest's name over the music. The BGM beat drops slightly in brightness but retains its rhythmic drive. A final series of digital transition blips and a sustained crowd roar close out the audio track.
